d:
Aaj banaie Dal Chawal Fara Recipe, Protein packed Gluten free svadisht aur khubsurat phul phare. bhap men kuk huye, yani tel bhi bahut kam,ek svadisht aur alag tarah ka bhartiy nashta. agar aap kam tel men banne vala halka-phulka nashta dhundh rahe hain to ye Gluten Free Rice Fara Recipe aapke liye hi hai. ye Healthy Tiffin Recipe bhi hai.
Ingredients for Rice Fara Recipe
For Fara
Namak - Salt - 1.5 tsp
Tel - Oil - 3 tsp
Chaval ka aata - Rice Flour - 1 cup (140g)
Mung dal - Moong Dal - ½ cup (100g)
Besan - Gram Flour - ½ cup (50g)
